aries.text: Engaging or frustrating? You might wind up in a dynamic dialogue—or a tense conflict—as “wounded healer” comet Chiron in Aries faces off with retrograde Venus in your relationship realm. A recent trouble in paradise may demand airtime, or an old grievance could resurface looking for resolution. Stand up for what you need, particularly if the end result is a balance that’s fair to you both. With the love planet in reverse, this is about correcting an inequity that’s been building for a while, not winning the exchange.

taurus.text: Romance and self-care share a lane today, Bull. As retrograde Venus in your sixth house of daily rhythms faces off with healer comet Chiron, you may notice how much your relationship habits mirror your other ones. Have you been giving more than you receive, at home and everywhere else? Work the tension out with a solid sweat session, then revisit a ritual that used to keep you and the other person connected. With Venus in reverse, restoring what worked before beats inventing something new.

gemini.text: Even if you’re normally pretty easy-breezy, your mood could turn theatrical today when retrograde Venus in your passionate fifth house goes toe to toe with “wounded healer” comet Chiron. Flirtations could get complicated fast, especially with someone from your romantic past. It’s fine to let your feelings out. But try not to become a stubborn holdout if conflict is brewing, particularly over something you thought you’d both moved past. Dial down the drama and check your ego at the door.

cancer.text: When retrograde Venus and Chiron face off today, you may find yourself wandering down memory lane. Has distance crept in between you and someone you love? Take the reins and reach out across the divide. Lean into your sentimental mood and send a photo from back when, or have dinner delivered from the restaurant where you had your first date. They’ll be touched. With the love planet in reverse, someone you lost track of entirely could resurface this week.

leo.text: Nothing is too touchy to talk about today when retrograde Venus in your communication zone goes head to head with healing comet Chiron in your expansion realm. This is your opening to raise the subject you’ve been circling with your partner for weeks. Lose the judgment and keep an open mind, and look for the bigger meaning behind whatever surfaces. A word of warning, though: This feisty faceoff could pivot a tender conversation into a heated one. Keep everything above the belt and don’t assume you’ll see eye to eye by the end.

virgo.text: Love and money tangle today, Virgo, as retrograde Venus and healing comet Chiron connect across your financial houses. Maybe you’re splitting an expense unevenly with your partner, or you’ve been quietly covering more than your share. Set aside worries about “offending” anyone by speaking up. You have every right to look out for yourself, and the most generous thing you can do for a relationship is keep resentment from taking root. With Venus in reverse, this is the week to settle what’s gone unspoken.

libra.text: You don’t need to stifle your impulses entirely, Libra, but tap into your innate diplomacy to navigate today’s stormy skies. You probably won’t realize that your words pack a punch as retrograde Venus in your sign goes up against “wounded healer” comet Chiron in your relationship arena. An offhand remark could hit a nerve with your sweetheart, or your cordial request may land more like an order. If you need a favor, start with kind qualifiers like “If you don’t mind…” and end with sincere thanks. And if you must hold a line, modulate your bark into a purr.

scorpio.text: Today’s connection between retrograde Venus in your cathartic twelfth house and comet Chiron in your sixth can offer just the healing you need, even if it stings a little at first. If old romantic baggage floats to the surface, seize the chance to unpack it. You might spot a pattern you keep repeating in relationships, or realize there’s a repair you owe someone from your past. Awareness is the first step, but if you know what action to take, don’t hesitate.

sagittarius.text: Rally your people! A motivating faceoff between retrograde Venus in your friendship sector and healer comet Chiron in your fifth house of romance can unleash serious energy. Just watch the line between platonic and something more, which may blur considerably today. An old flame in your friend group could stir things up, or a friendship might start tilting toward flirtation. Don’t allow the friction to take an ugly turn, and don’t make any declarations you’d need to walk back.

capricorn.text: The tension between your career and your personal life may be impossible to ignore as retrograde Venus in your ambition zone opposes wounded healer comet Chiron in your home and family sector. Has someone at home been getting the leftovers of your attention? With Venus backing up, this is the week to make it right, whether that means leaving the office on time or finally scheduling a weekend away you keep postponing. Your relationships deserve the same effort you give your ambitions. But stop short of slipping into sacrificial mode for your loved ones.

aquarius.text: There’s no shortage of inspiration today, thanks to a faceoff between retrograde Venus in your expansion realm and numinous Chiron in your communication zone. A conversation with someone you love could catalyze blue-sky visions, and you might find yourself discussing the big questions: What do we actually want? Where are we headed together? Don’t rein yourself in, but don’t book anything yet either. With the love planet in reverse, this transit is better suited to examining what you want than to making any promises. If the talk brushes up against an old sore spot, that’s worth noticing too.

pisces.text: Are you ready to go THERE? When retrograde Venus in your depth sector faces off with healer comet Chiron today, a Big Talk may seem inevitable. Have you opened a joint bank account, said “I do” or merged your life with someone else’s in another way? It’s crucial to make sure you’re on the same wavelength. Today’s charged vibe lends you the courage to lay it all on the line. As you work through your differences, identify the areas of agreement rather than taking a combative stance. Everything doesn’t have to be even-steven, but do strive to share as fairly as possible.
